purpose: Test whether full 2x2 investment-assurance G times rare-mutant beta predicts the exact one-generation multivariate Price response without dropping G_ia.
exact_response: Delta mean(investment,assurance) from density_step; equivalently exact multivariate Price covariance identity
lande_response: G_ia_full_2x2 @ beta where beta is rare-mutant log-invasion gradient evaluated at the current mean phenotype in the fixed population environment

gates.off_diagonal_requirement: compute with observed G_ia and also diagonalized G control; never assume G_ia=0
